verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a bill-intake flow in which a dragged-in vendor invoice is matched to its PO, coded to a GL account, routed for approval and paid. Its agents learn from past invoices and apply that logic during processing, with human confirmation before money moves, which covers the 'for my review' part. The evidence never explicitly says AI extracts payment details such as amount, due date or vendor bank info from the bill to pre-fill the payment. missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI extraction of payment fields from incoming bills, description of the review screen for auto-populated details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI read incoming bills and auto-populate payment details for my review

citations.quote: A vendor invoice is dragged into Ramp, automatically matched to its PO, coded to the right GL account, routed for approval, and paid
Learning from past invoices, Ramp's agent applies your logic instantly during processing
No money ever moves without a human confirmation
